lines.beaver_en: Are you still writing regularly these days?
lines.en: Yes, writing is a great joy for me.

lines.beaver_en: You write book reviews too, right?
lines.learner: 네, 지난주에 소설 서평을 하나 썼어요.
lines.en: Yes, I wrote a review of a novel last week.
lines.roman: Ne, jinanjue soseol seopyeongeul hana sseosseoyo.

lines.en: It's a family novel about talking by a bonfire.
A new writer, and the sentences are really fresh.

lines.beaver_en: Were there many literary expressions too?
lines.en: Yes, the literary expressions sparkled like beads.

lines.beaver_en: Have you thought about publishing a book?
lines.en: Someday I'd like to write my own novel.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of story do you want to write?
lines.en: A story about playing marbles with my grandma as a kid.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any other hobbies besides writing?
lines.learner: 아니요, 주말 글쓰기만으로도 즐겁기가 이를 데 없어요.
lines.en: No, writing on weekends alone is extremely enjoyable.
lines.roman: Aniyo, jumal geulsseugimaneurodo jeulgeopkkiga ireul de eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Would you read your writing at the next meeting?
lines.en: Sure. I'll bring a new book review.

lines.beaver_en: I'll look forward to it. I enjoyed our talk today.
lines.en: Me too. See you at the next meeting.
